name: Stowe & Burlington
summary: Postcard Vermont: a steepled village under Mount Mansfield, ice cream from the source, and a lakefront college town.

lodging.name: Trapp Family Lodge, Stowe
lodging.blurb: Austrian-style mountain lodge founded by the von Trapps of Sound of Music fame — meadows, trails, and a brewery.

foodMustTry.name: A Ben & Jerry's factory scoop
foodMustTry.blurb: Tour the Waterbury factory and pay respects at the Flavor Graveyard of discontinued pints.

foodMustTry.name: Vermont cheddar & a maple creemee
foodMustTry.blurb: Sharp local cheddar and a maple soft-serve are the state's signatures.

days.label: Day 15 — Stowe Village & Ben & Jerry's
days.summary: Mountain village, the ridgeline of Mansfield, and ice cream.

item.title: Ben & Jerry's Factory Tour
item.blurb: A short factory tour ending in samples, plus the tongue-in-cheek Flavor Graveyard out back.

item.title: Mount Mansfield Auto Toll Road
item.blurb: Drive or hike to the ridgeline of Vermont's highest peak for foliage views across the Greens.

days.label: Day 16 — Burlington & Lake Champlain
days.summary: Lakefront college town — pedestrian marketplace and a sunset over the Adirondacks.

item.title: Church Street Marketplace
item.blurb: A brick pedestrian mall of local shops, buskers, and cafés in the heart of Burlington.

item.title: Lake Champlain waterfront sunset
item.blurb: The sun dropping behind the Adirondacks across the lake.

days.label: Day 17 — Drive south to New York City
days.summary: The long, beautiful descent out of New England into the biggest city on the trip.

commute.scenicNote: The longest Northeast leg — break it in the Hudson Valley to keep it humane.

stopsAlongWay.title: Hudson Valley farm stand
stopsAlongWay.blurb: Apples, cider doughnuts, and foliage on the way down.
